interests.title: Laws of the universe & NVIDIA technologies
interests.intro: Beyond IT: a fascination for the laws that govern the universe and those that push the limits of graphical rendering.
interests.universeSubtitle: Six fundamental principles, illustrated with animated graphs.

laws.name: Entropy
laws.desc: Second law of thermodynamics: the disorder of an isolated system can only increase.

laws.name: Mass–energy equivalence
laws.desc: A tiny mass hides colossal energy — the principle behind stars and nuclear power.

laws.name: Speed of light
laws.desc: The absolute limit of causality: nothing travels faster than light in a vacuum.

laws.name: Gravitation
laws.desc: Two masses attract each other: the force that shapes orbits, stars and galaxies.

laws.name: Exponential growth
laws.desc: Compounding gains turn dizzying — Moore's law is its technological incarnation.

laws.name: Chaos — butterfly effect
laws.desc: A tiny change in initial conditions diverges exponentially: extreme sensitivity.

interests.nvidiaSubtitle: The building blocks of modern rendering, explained simply.

nvidia.name: DLSS
nvidia.desc: AI reconstructs a high-resolution image from a lighter one: more FPS, near-native quality.

nvidia.name: Frame Generation
nvidia.desc: AI generates intermediate frames between two rendered frames, multiplying perceived smoothness.

nvidia.name: Ray Tracing
nvidia.desc: Physical simulation of light paths: reflections, shadows and photorealistic lighting.

nvidia.name: CUDA cores
nvidia.desc: Thousands of small parallel compute cores: the GPU's raw, versatile power.

nvidia.name: Tensor cores
nvidia.desc: Units dedicated to AI matrix math — the engine that runs DLSS.

nvidia.name: RT cores
nvidia.desc: Hardware accelerators for ray/geometry intersection tests (ultra-fast BVH traversal).

nvidia.name: VRAM
nvidia.desc: Fast memory dedicated to textures and 3D data; too little, and FPS collapses.

nvidia.name: Resizable BAR
nvidia.desc: The CPU accesses the whole VRAM in one block instead of small chunks: better flow, more FPS.

nvidia.name: VSR
nvidia.desc: Video Super Resolution: AI enhances online video quality in real time on the GPU.

nvidia.name: NIS
nvidia.desc: NVIDIA Image Scaling: spatial upscaling and sharpening, no AI, available on any GPU.

nvidia.name: Reflex
nvidia.desc: Cuts mouse-to-screen latency for near-instant response in games.

nvidia.name: NVENC
nvidia.desc: Dedicated hardware video encoder: streaming and recording without loading the CPU.
